deepSwePricing.policy: Match DeepSWE displayed pricing, including its promotional and peak-rate choices.

benchmarks.label: Intelligence Index
benchmarks.description: Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index v4.3, a weighted composite of 10 independently run evaluations.
benchmarks.costNote: Weighted average cost per Intelligence Index task.

benchmarks.label: AA Coding Agent Index v1.5
benchmarks.description: An equally weighted composite of DeepSWE v1.1, SWE-Atlas-QnA, Terminal-Bench v4. Each component averages pass@1 across repeated attempts per task.
benchmarks.costNote: Average observed pay-per-token API cost per task, including cached-input discounts and cache-write pricing where Artificial Analysis has that telemetry.

benchmarks.label: AA-Briefcase
benchmarks.description: Agentic knowledge work across 91 tasks in four multi-week business projects. The headline Elo combines rubric checks, analytical quality, and presentation.

benchmarks.label: GDPval-AA v2
benchmarks.description: Measures agentic performance on 220 economically valuable tasks across 44 occupations and nine industries. Models browse, use a shell, and produce realistic deliverables such as spreadsheets, presentations, documents, and diagrams.

benchmarks.label: AutomationBench-AA
benchmarks.description: Workflow automation across 657 tasks in simulated business applications. Scores measure the share of objectives completed, with zero credit when a guardrail is violated.

benchmarks.label: Terminal-Bench 4.0
benchmarks.description: A harder set of 66 terminal tasks across software, science, operations, and security. Artificial Analysis reports pass@1 averaged over three attempts per task.

benchmarks.label: SciCode
benchmarks.description: A scientist-curated coding evaluation with 288 subproblems drawn from 80 laboratory problems across 16 scientific disciplines. It requires both domain reasoning and correct implementation of research-oriented numerical code.

benchmarks.label: Humanity’s Last Exam
benchmarks.description: Expert-vetted academic questions across mathematics, science, engineering, humanities, and social science, using AA’s evaluated subset.
benchmarks.costNote: Average cost per Humanity’s Last Exam task.

benchmarks.label: GDP.pdf
benchmarks.description: Professional reasoning over long PDF documents across 100 tasks and ten domains. The All-pass score counts attempts that satisfy every grading criterion.

benchmarks.label: CritPt
benchmarks.description: Tests research-scale physics reasoning with composite challenges. Answers include symbolic expressions, numerical arrays, and executable functions.

benchmarks.label: AA-Omniscience
benchmarks.description: Measures factual reliability across 6,000 questions, 42 topics, and six economically relevant domains. The index rewards correct answers, penalizes confident hallucinations, and does not penalize abstention.

benchmarks.label: AA-LCR v1.1
benchmarks.description: Evaluates whether models can retrieve, connect, and synthesize evidence from documents ranging from roughly 10,000 to 100,000 tokens. It targets reasoning over distant context, not simple needle retrieval.

benchmarks.label: τ³-Banking
benchmarks.description: Tests customer-support agents on realistic banking workflows. Success requires searching a large policy knowledge base, maintaining conversational state, and executing the correct sequence of tool calls without violating constraints.
benchmarks.refreshNote: Current source no longer provides score/cost pairs; retained the previous snapshot.

benchmarks.label: Terminal-Bench v2.1
benchmarks.description: Evaluates agents on 89 verified terminal tasks across software engineering, system administration, security, data processing, and model training. Each task runs in a real sandbox and is checked by an executable verification suite.
benchmarks.costNote: Average cost per Terminal-Bench v2.1 task.
benchmarks.refreshNote: Current source no longer provides score/cost pairs; retained the previous snapshot.

benchmarks.label: GPQA Diamond
benchmarks.description: The hardest 198 questions from GPQA, written and validated by domain experts in physics, biology, and chemistry. The questions are deliberately Google-resistant and require graduate-level scientific reasoning.
benchmarks.costNote: Average cost per GPQA Diamond task.
benchmarks.refreshNote: Current source no longer provides score/cost pairs; retained the previous snapshot.

benchmarks.label: FrontierCode 1.1 Main
benchmarks.pricingNote: Source-reported costs; a complete token and rate breakdown is unavailable for independent repricing.
benchmarks.description: Cognition’s quality-focused coding benchmark asks whether an open-source maintainer would merge the generated change. Main contains 100 difficult tasks and scores correctness, tests, scope discipline, style, and codebase standards across five rollouts per effort.
benchmarks.costNote: Average model/API cost per FrontierCode Main task; the plotted score is the quality-adjusted mergeability score.

benchmarks.label: DeepSWE v1.1
benchmarks.pricingNote: Costs use DeepSWE’s updated API rates, including its promotional and peak-rate choices.
benchmarks.description: A contamination-resistant, long-horizon software-engineering benchmark with 113 original tasks across 91 repositories and five languages. Hand-written behavioral verifiers score complete mini-swe-agent rollouts rather than patches copied from historical pull requests.
benchmarks.costNote: Mean rollout cost using DeepSWE’s displayed pricing adjustments, including promotional and peak-rate choices. Pass@1 is unchanged.

benchmarks.label: LiveBench 2026-06-25
benchmarks.pricingNote: Source-reported run costs; not uniformly repriced to current API rates.
benchmarks.description: A contamination-conscious benchmark of 23 objective tasks across reasoning, coding, agentic coding, mathematics, data analysis, language, and instruction following. Questions refresh every six months and are graded against verifiable answers.
benchmarks.costNote: Published cost per successful task, which combines per-question spend with the model’s success rate rather than showing raw API price.
